errors.evidence: The description claims the F1 value is approximately 58.0% at λ ≈ 0.7. However, the value at λ=0.7 is approximately 59.2%. The value 58.0% is not reached until λ is approximately 0.82.
The description states the value at λ = 1.0 is approximately 57.2%. The plot shows the value at λ=0.9 is approximately 57.2%, and the value at λ=1.0 is slightly lower, at approximately 57.1%.
